title: Original Irish source · archived diagnosis
headline: An importer issue was corrected. The Irish case is not yet an independently validated operational model.

findings.label: Ideal bus-tie treatment corrected
findings.detail: 148 active tie branches connect exactly equal saved voltages. Merging them reduces the largest source P residual from 334.812 to 4.312 MW.

findings.label: RAW rounding explains large local residual scale
findings.detail: All remaining P/Q residuals fit a conservative voltage-rounding envelope; this does not prove a joint exact reproduction.

findings.label: Source voltage limits already violated
findings.detail: 173 source bus voltages violate their own recorded normal limits. All 173 are below 100 kV; none are at or above 100 kV.

findings.label: Three numerical algorithms agree
findings.detail: Newton, fast-decoupled XB and BX agree on the same imported network. This is not a separate importer or source-tool validation.

findings.label: Exact source reproduction unresolved
findings.detail: Maximum solved difference: 0.000024614 pu voltage magnitude and 0.031183degrees phase angle.

findings.label: Source control behavior incomplete
findings.detail: HVDC boundary P/Q calibrated; remote regulation not reproduced; internal ideal-tie flows not checked.

claim_allowed: Exploratory comparison of declared planning scenarios with unresolved checks shown.
claim_not_allowed: Validated 37 MW curtailment reduction, a safe operational action, or an Ireland-wide reduction percentage.
summary: Historical source/conversion diagnosis retained for traceability. Its legacy comparison is retired. The separate Irish conditional-study report below contains the new, explicitly transformed planning experiment.
